description: This file defines the Percentiles class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for statistical calculations such as percentile, percentile rank, quartile, and rank functions. It contains static methods implementing these calculations, utilizing external validation and error classes.

classes.name: Percentiles
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate statistical metrics such as percentiles, rank, and quartiles within spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: PERCENTILE
methods.description: Calculates the nth percentile of a given set of values according to the specified entry (percentile rank).

methods.name: PERCENTRANK
methods.description: Calculates the rank of a value in a data set as a percentage.

methods.name: QUARTILE
methods.description: Returns the quartile value of a data set based on the specified quartile number.

methods.name: RANK
methods.description: Determines the rank of a specific value within a data set, either ascending or descending.
